cover.explanation: The PR claims a plain fix (bug label, 'fixes something and does not need a WG/RFC'), and the base-branch docs state the intended behavior it restores: the cloud configuration guide says discovery captures the context window from the provider's context_length and runs at every cache build, so the post-load reset to 32768 with max_context_window dropped is a deviation, not intended behavior. The backend guide's statement that ctx_size is opt-in via uses_ctx_size covers skipping ctx_size auto-injection for cloud backends. Issue #3573 supplies evidence of the deviation; no working-group charter or RFC is needed.

surfaces.by: base-branch docs/guide/configuration/cloud.md, 'How discovery works': '- **Context window** — from `context_length`, when reported.' and 'Discovery runs at every cache build (server startup, install, auth)' — the provider-discovered context window is what a discovered cloud model's metadata is supposed to carry, so resetting it to the local 32768 fallback after load contradicts the documented contract; and base-branch docs/dev/adding-a-backend.md: 'ctx_size is opt-in via `uses_ctx_size`' — covering the part that stops auto-injecting ctx_size at load for backends that don't declare it. The facts pass flagged the surface 'was: failing' with context_length, max_context_window, ctx_size, and uses_ctx_size already present in base-branch source, i.e. a fix by the existing contract.

explanation.body: The title, body, and template claims describe what the diff does.
explanation.diff: The diff fixes #3573 in two places: populate_model_metadata in src/cpp/server/model_manager.cpp stops zeroing max_context_window for dynamic-models backends (cloud) so the provider's discovery value survives cache rebuilds, and Router::load_model in src/cpp/server/router.cpp skips ctx_size auto-tuning for backends whose descriptor lacks uses_ctx_size, so the 32768 memory-fallback no longer overwrites cloud context or leaks into loaded recipe_options. test/server_endpoints.py extends the mock provider to advertise context_length and asserts the 262144 value before and after chat/load plus no ctx_size in /health, which is the regression the body describes. The body matches the diff; the behavior change is a fix restoring the provider-advertised value, so no breaking changes are introduced.
explanation.quality: Checked docs/api/openai.md, docs/api/lemonade.md, and docs/guide/configuration/cloud.md: cloud.md already documents the provider context_length mapping the fix restores, but openai.md's max_context_window field note omits cloud models and is now untrue. The regression extends test/server_endpoints.py (test_012d_cloud_install_then_auth_then_chat) with exact-value assertions verified to fail on main, and the full suite runs in the endpoint jobs of cpp_server_build_test_release.yml on Linux and Windows. Docs to do: Add cloud models to the max_context_window field note in docs/api/openai.md.
